t: ⏱ T-24h · Pulong ng Master, C/O, C/E, 2/E
i: Ορίστε escorts: Master/C/O για γέφυρα & deck, C/E ή 2/E για ER. Ο καθένας με VHF/UHF, φακό και σημειωματάριο.
Assign escorts: Master/C/O for bridge & deck, C/E or 2/E for ER. Each one with radio, torch and notebook.
Magtalaga ng escort: Master/C/O sa bridge at deck, C/E o 2/E sa ER. May radio, flashlight at notebook bawat isa.
Κλειδιά έτοιμα & χώροι ανοιχτοί: CO2 room, em'cy generator room, em'cy fire pump, steering gear, paint store, battery room, foam room, foc'sle store.
Keys ready & spaces open: CO2 room, emergency generator room, emergency fire pump, steering gear, paint store, battery room, foam room, forecastle store.
Handa ang mga susi at bukas ang: CO2 room, emergency generator room, emergency fire pump, steering gear, paint store, battery room, foam room, forecastle store.

Λίστα με τα tests που θα ζητήσει και υπεύθυνος για το καθένα: OWS 15 ppm, em'cy fire pump, em'cy generator, engineers' alarm, dead man, lifeboat engine, BNWAS, nav lights, emergency steering, bilge alarms, WIDS.

List the tests he will ask for, with one responsible person each: OWS 15 ppm, emergency fire pump, emergency generator, engineers' alarm, dead man alarm, lifeboat engine, BNWAS, nav lights, emergency steering, bilge alarms, WIDS.

Ilista ang mga test na hihingin niya, may isang responsable bawat isa: OWS 15 ppm, emergency fire pump, emergency generator, engineers' alarm, dead man alarm, lifeboat engine, BNWAS, nav lights, emergency steering, bilge alarms, WIDS.
Crew list = Safe Manning Certificate (αριθμός και βαθμοί).
Crew list matches the Safe Manning Certificate (number and ranks).
Tugma ang crew list sa Safe Manning Certificate (bilang at ranggo).
Officer matrix με τους ΤΩΡΙΝΟΥΣ αξιωματικούς (μετά από αλλαγή πληρώματος ενημερώστε το).
Officer matrix shows the CURRENT officers (update after every crew change).
Ang officer matrix ay may KASALUKUYANG mga officer (i-update pagkatapos ng crew change).
Όποιος ήρθε τελευταίος: familiarisation πλήρης και υπογεγραμμένη. Ο inspector ρωτάει συχνά τον πιο καινούριο.
Newest crew member: familiarisation complete and signed. The inspector often asks the newest person.
Pinakabagong crew: kumpleto at pirmado ang familiarisation. Madalas tanungin ng inspector ang pinakabago.
Σήμερα μόνο τελειώματα: καμία νέα μεγάλη δουλειά, κανένα hot work αύριο, κανένα μηχάνημα ανοιχτό την ώρα της επιθεώρησης.
Today only finishing work: no new big jobs, no hot work tomorrow, no machinery opened up during the inspection.
Ngayon, tapusin lang ang mga trabaho: walang bagong malaking trabaho, walang hot work bukas, walang makinang bukas habang may inspection.
Class Survey Status Report ≤7 ημερών. Αν είναι παλιότερο, ζήτα νέο ΣΗΜΕΡΑ. Όλα τα certificates σε ισχύ, κανένα overdue CoC/survey, dispensations με εξήγηση.
Class Survey Status Report not older than 7 days – if older, request a new one TODAY. All certificates valid, no overdue CoC/survey, dispensations explained.
Class Survey Status Report na hindi lalampas ng 7 araw – kung luma, humingi ng bago NGAYON. Valid lahat ng certificate, walang overdue na CoC/survey, may paliwanag ang dispensations.
Τα 2 MLC financial security certificates σε ισχύ και αναρτημένα.
Both MLC financial security certificates valid and posted.
Valid at nakapaskil ang 2 MLC financial security certificate.
Rest hours όλων, τελευταίες 4 εβδομάδες: σε ILO format, υπογεγραμμένα, κάθε παραβίαση με σχόλιο/corrective action.
Rest hours of all crew, last 4 weeks: ILO format, signed, every non-conformity with comment/corrective action.
Rest hours ng lahat, huling 4 na linggo: ILO format, pirmado, bawat paglabag may komento/corrective action.
Drills σύμφωνα με το πρόγραμμα (abandon ship & fire μηνιαία) με debrief και lessons learnt. ΜΗΝ γράψεις drill που δεν έγινε.
Drills as per schedule (abandon ship & fire monthly) with debrief and lessons learnt. NEVER record a drill that was not done.
Drills ayon sa schedule (abandon ship at fire buwan-buwan) may debrief at lessons learnt. HUWAG isulat ang drill na hindi ginawa.
Enclosed space rescue drill ≤2 μηνών, σε διαφορετικούς χώρους του register.
Enclosed space rescue drill within the last 2 months, in different spaces of the register.
Enclosed space rescue drill sa loob ng huling 2 buwan, sa iba't ibang space sa register.
Τελευταίο enclosed space permit: πλήρες, gas readings γραμμένα (O₂ 20.9%, HC <1% LFL, toxic <50% OEL), υπογραφές, κλεισμένο. Ο inspector παίρνει το ΤΕΛΕΥΤΑΙΟ.
Last enclosed space permit: complete, gas readings written (O₂ 20.9%, HC <1% LFL, toxic <50% OEL), signed, closed. The inspector takes the LAST one.
Huling enclosed space permit: kumpleto, nakasulat ang gas readings (O₂ 20.9%, HC <1% LFL, toxic <50% OEL), pirmado, sarado. Ang HULI ang kukunin ng inspector.
Τελευταίο hot work permit: gas test, fire watch, risk assessment, έγκριση γραφείου αν έγινε εκτός workshop.
Last hot work permit: gas test, fire watch, risk assessment, office approval if outside the workshop.
Huling hot work permit: gas test, fire watch, risk assessment, approval ng office kung labas ng workshop.
ORB Part I: εγγραφές μέχρι σήμερα, σωστά codes, υπογραφές κάθε εγγραφής και Master σε κάθε σελίδα, ποσότητες = soundings.
ORB Part I: entries up to today, correct codes, each entry signed and Master signs each page, quantities match soundings.
ORB Part I: entries hanggang ngayon, tamang codes, pirmado bawat entry at pirma ng Master bawat pahina, tugma ang dami sa soundings.
Ballast Water Record Book & BWMP: τελευταίες εργασίες γραμμένες, BWTS records/alarms εξηγημένα.
Ballast Water Record Book & BWMP: last operations recorded, BWTS records/alarms explained.
Ballast Water Record Book at BWMP: nakasulat ang huling operations, may paliwanag ang BWTS records/alarms.
Garbage Record Book & receipts, Garbage Management Plan, placards αναρτημένα.
Garbage Record Book & receipts, Garbage Management Plan, placards posted.
Garbage Record Book at receipts, Garbage Management Plan, nakapaskil ang placards.
PMS: κανένα overdue job. Αν υπάρχει, postponement εγκεκριμένο από γραφείο.
PMS: no overdue jobs. If any, postponement approved by the office.
PMS: walang overdue na job. Kung meron, may approved na postponement mula sa office.
Safety committee minutes τελευταίου μήνα, με απάντηση γραφείου. Near-miss reports σε αρχείο.
Safety committee minutes of last month with office reply. Near-miss reports on file.
Safety committee minutes ng nakaraang buwan na may sagot ng office. Naka-file ang near-miss reports.
Standing orders υπογεγραμμένα από ΟΛΟΥΣ τους αξιωματικούς (και τους νέους). Night orders μέχρι χθες, countersigned.
Standing orders signed by ALL officers (new ones too). Night orders up to last night, countersigned.
Standing orders pirmado ng LAHAT ng officer (pati bago). Night orders hanggang kagabi, countersigned.
Όλα τα έγγραφα σε φακέλους στο γραφείο του Master, με τη σειρά του RISQ (Section 2 → 15).
All documents in folders in the Master's office, in RISQ order (Section 2 → 15).
Lahat ng dokumento sa folder sa opisina ng Master, ayon sa RISQ order (Section 2 → 15).
ENC/charts: εφαρμοσμένα τα updates αυτής της εβδομάδας, ENC permits σε ισχύ, publications τελευταία έκδοση.
ENC/charts: this week's updates applied, ENC permits valid, publications latest edition.
ENC/charts: nailagay ang updates ngayong linggo, valid ang ENC permits, pinakabagong edition ang publications.
Passage plan berth-to-berth (τρέχον/επόμενο ταξίδι) εγκεκριμένο από Master: XTL, no-go areas, abort points, parallel indexing.
Berth-to-berth passage plan (current/next voyage) approved by Master: XTL, no-go areas, abort points, parallel indexing.
Berth-to-berth passage plan (kasalukuyan/susunod na voyage) approved ng Master: XTL, no-go areas, abort points, parallel indexing.
Τελευταίο ταξίδι στο ECDIS: safety contour/depth σωστά, κανένας κίνδυνος μέσα στο XTL.
Last voyage on ECDIS: safety contour/depth correct, no danger inside the XTL.
Huling voyage sa ECDIS: tama ang safety contour/depth, walang panganib sa loob ng XTL.
Daily/weekly/monthly tests bridge equipment γραμμένα μέχρι σήμερα. Compass error κάθε βάρδια.
Daily/weekly/monthly bridge equipment tests recorded up to today. Compass error every watch.
Naka-record hanggang ngayon ang daily/weekly/monthly tests ng bridge equipment. Compass error bawat watch.
Deviation card <2 ετών, magnetic compass χωρίς φυσαλίδα, gyro service κατά maker.
Deviation card less than 2 years old, magnetic compass without bubble, gyro serviced as per maker.
Deviation card na wala pang 2 taon, walang bula ang magnetic compass, serviced ang gyro ayon sa maker.
BNWAS ON (θάλασσα & αγκυροβόλιο) και records.
BNWAS ON (at sea & at anchor) with records.
BNWAS ON (sa dagat at naka-angkla) may records.
Nav lights & emergency nav lights test, NUC lights, shapes, whistle, Aldis με λάμπα & φορτισμένη μπαταρία.
Test nav lights & emergency nav lights, NUC lights, shapes, whistle, Aldis lamp with bulb & charged battery.
I-test ang nav lights at emergency nav lights, NUC lights, shapes, whistle, Aldis lamp may bombilya at charged na battery.
Ρολόγια συγχρονισμένα: γέφυρα, GMDSS, VDR, ECR, alarm printer.
Clocks synchronised: bridge, GMDSS, VDR, ECR, alarm printer.
Pare-pareho ang oras: bridge, GMDSS, VDR, ECR, alarm printer.
Ο OOW ξέρει να σώσει VDR data (save button + procedure). Κάντε πρόβα σήμερα.
OOW knows how to save VDR data (save button + procedure). Rehearse today.
Alam ng OOW kung paano i-save ang VDR data (save button + procedure). Mag-ensayo ngayon.
GMDSS log: daily tests, weekly DSC test, monthly batteries, reserve source σωστά.
GMDSS log: daily tests, weekly DSC test, monthly batteries, reserve source recorded.
GMDSS log: daily tests, weekly DSC test, monthly batteries, naka-record ang reserve source.
EPIRB: battery & HRU σε ισχύ, annual test, 5-yearly shore maintenance.
EPIRB: battery & HRU valid, annual test, 5-yearly shore maintenance.
EPIRB: valid ang battery at HRU, annual test, 5-yearly shore maintenance.
SART/AIS-SART & portable GMDSS VHF (11.7): ημερομηνίες μπαταριών σε ισχύ, sealed batteries άθικτες.
SART/AIS-SART & portable GMDSS VHF (11.7): battery dates valid, sealed batteries intact.
SART/AIS-SART at portable GMDSS VHF (11.7): valid ang petsa ng battery, buo ang sealed batteries.
AIS: draft, destination, ETA, nav status σωστά σήμερα.
AIS: draft, destination, ETA, nav status correct today.
AIS: tama ngayon ang draft, destination, ETA, nav status.
SSAS: τελευταίο test σε record, οι αξιωματικοί ξέρουν πώς λειτουργεί (χωρίς να το δείξουν σε ξένους).
SSAS: last test recorded, officers know how it works (without showing its location to visitors).
SSAS: naka-record ang huling test, alam ng officers kung paano gumagana (huwag ipakita sa bisita kung nasaan).
Lifeboat: εκκίνηση μηχανής σήμερα (ahead/astern), falls, release gear, equipment πλήρες, ημερομηνίες annual & 5-yearly service.
Lifeboat: start engine today (ahead/astern), falls, release gear, equipment complete, annual & 5-yearly service dates.
Lifeboat: paandarin ang makina ngayon (ahead/astern), falls, release gear, kumpleto ang equipment, petsa ng annual at 5-yearly service.
Liferafts: service date, HRU σε ισχύ, weak link ΣΩΣΤΑ συνδεδεμένο, painter δεμένο στο πλοίο.
Liferafts: service date, HRU valid, weak link CORRECTLY connected, painter secured to the ship.
Liferafts: service date, valid ang HRU, TAMA ang pagkakabit ng weak link, nakatali sa barko ang painter.
Lifebuoys: self-igniting light & MOB smoke σε ισχύ, lines, όνομα πλοίου/λιμάνι, IMO symbols.
Lifebuoys: self-igniting lights & MOB smoke valid, lines, ship name/port, IMO symbols.
Lifebuoys: valid ang self-igniting light at MOB smoke, may lines, pangalan ng barko/port, IMO symbols.
Lifejackets: lights σε ισχύ, whistle, κατανομή. Immersion suits (4.21) ελεγμένα, donning instructions.
Lifejackets: lights valid, whistle, distribution. Immersion suits (4.21) checked, donning instructions.
Lifejackets: valid ang ilaw, may whistle, distribution. Immersion suits (4.21) na-check, may donning instructions.
Κάθε fire box: hose, nozzle, spanner στη θέση. Hydrants ανοίγουν, δεν στάζουν, hoses χωρίς σκισίματα.
Every fire box: hose, nozzle, spanner in place. Hydrants open, no leaks, hoses not damaged.
Bawat fire box: nasa lugar ang hose, nozzle, spanner. Bumubukas ang hydrants, walang tagas, walang sira ang hose.
Portable extinguishers: σφραγίδα, πίεση στο πράσινο, annual tag, στη θέση του fire plan.
Portable extinguishers: seal, pressure in green, annual tag, in the fire plan position.
Portable extinguishers: may seal, green ang pressure, may annual tag, nasa lugar ayon sa fire plan.
Fireman's outfits πλήρη (axe, ATEX lamp, lifeline, boots, gloves, helmet). SCBA γεμάτες + 2 spare φιάλες ανά set. ATEX radios.
Fireman's outfits complete (axe, ATEX lamp, lifeline, boots, gloves, helmet). SCBA full + 2 spare cylinders per set. ATEX radios.
Kumpleto ang fireman's outfit (axe, ATEX lamp, lifeline, boots, gloves, helmet). Puno ang SCBA + 2 spare cylinder bawat set. ATEX radios.
EEBDs στη θέση, gauge στο πράσινο, ημερομηνία service.
EEBDs in place, gauge in green, service date.
Nasa lugar ang EEBDs, green ang gauge, may service date.
Fire detection panel: ΚΑΝΕΝΑ fault/disablement. Αν υπάρχει, εξήγηση και ενέργεια γραμμένα.
Fire detection panel: NO faults/disablements. If any, explanation and action recorded.
Fire detection panel: WALANG fault/disablement. Kung meron, nakasulat ang paliwanag at aksyon.
CO2 room: record ελέγχου ποσότητας, alarms, κλειδί στο κουτί, οδηγίες αναρτημένες.
CO2 room: quantity check record, alarms, key in its box, instructions posted.
CO2 room: record ng quantity check, alarms, nasa kahon ang susi, nakapaskil ang instructions.
Fire dampers/flaps σημασμένα (open/close + space served) και κλείνουν.
Fire dampers/flaps marked (open/close + space served) and they close.
May marka ang fire dampers/flaps (open/close + space served) at sumasara.
International Shore Connection: bolts, nuts, gasket, σήμανση.
International Shore Connection: bolts, nuts, gasket, marking.
International Shore Connection: bolts, nuts, gasket, marking.
Portable gas detectors: calibration certificate, span gas σε ισχύ, bump test σήμερα.
Portable gas detectors: calibration certificate, span gas valid, bump test today.
Portable gas detectors: calibration certificate, valid ang span gas, bump test ngayon.
BA compressor: air quality test <12 μηνών.
BA compressor: air quality test within 12 months.
BA compressor: air quality test sa loob ng 12 buwan.
Fire Training Manual & SOLAS Training Manual ship-specific στο mess.
Ship-specific Fire Training Manual & SOLAS Training Manual in the mess room.
Ship-specific Fire Training Manual at SOLAS Training Manual sa mess room.
Gangway: safety net, lifebuoy με line, φωτισμός, σωστή ασφάλιση, ελεύθερο πέρασμα. Είναι η ΠΡΩΤΗ εικόνα.
Gangway: safety net, lifebuoy with line, lighting, properly secured, clear way. It is the FIRST impression.
Gangway: safety net, lifebuoy may line, ilaw, maayos na nakakabit, malinis na daanan. Ito ang UNANG makikita.
Gangway watch συνέχεια στη θέση: visitor log, έλεγχος ID, ISPS level αναρτημένο.
Gangway watch always in place: visitor log, ID check, ISPS level posted.
Laging nasa lugar ang gangway watch: visitor log, ID check, nakapaskil ang ISPS level.
Pilot ladder: certificate, ID tag, record χρήσης, ≤30 μήνες. Αν έρθει με launch, το rigging της σκάλας είναι ο πρώτος έλεγχος: κατά SOLAS V/23, lifebuoy με light, φως, αξιωματικός με VHF.
Pilot ladder: certificate, ID tag, record of use, not more than 30 months. If he comes by launch, ladder rigging is the first check: SOLAS V/23, lifebuoy with light, lighting, officer with radio.

Pilot ladder: certificate, ID tag, record of use, hindi lalampas ng 30 buwan. Kung darating siya sakay ng launch, ang rigging ng ladder ang unang check: SOLAS V/23, lifebuoy may ilaw, ilaw, officer may radio.
Mooring lines σωστά τυλιγμένες στα τύμπανα, brakes ON, out of gear. Split drums (10.9) σωστά.
Mooring lines correctly reeled on drums, brakes ON, out of gear. Split drums (10.9) correct.
Tama ang pagkakarolyo ng mooring lines sa drum, ON ang brakes, out of gear. Tama ang split drums (10.9).
Snap-back zones σημασμένα, signage, mooring stations καθαρές.
Snap-back zones marked, signage, mooring stations clean.
May marka ang snap-back zones, may signage, malinis ang mooring stations.
Heaving lines: monkey's fist ή soft pouch, ΧΩΡΙΣ βάρος μέσα.
Heaving lines: monkey's fist or soft pouch, NO weight inside.
Heaving lines: monkey's fist o soft pouch, WALANG pabigat sa loob.
Chain locker πόρτες κλειστές, bitter end release προσβάσιμο. Anchors (10.19) σφιχτά και δεμένα.
Chain locker doors closed, bitter end release accessible. Anchors (10.19) tight and secured.
Sarado ang pinto ng chain locker, abot ang bitter end release. Mahigpit at nakatali ang anchors (10.19).
Save-alls (deck machinery, bunker manifold 7A.1, vents 7A.4): καθαρά, στεγνά, τάπες στη θέση. ΚΑΝΕΝΑ λάδι στο deck.
Save-alls (deck machinery, bunker manifold 7A.1, vents 7A.4): clean, dry, plugs in place. NO oil on deck.
Save-alls (deck machinery, bunker manifold 7A.1, vents 7A.4): malinis, tuyo, nakalagay ang plug. WALANG langis sa deck.
Air pipes: σήμανση space served, closing devices λειτουργούν.
Air pipes: space served marked, closing devices working.
Air pipes: may marka ng space served, gumagana ang closing devices.
Weathertight doors κλείνουν σφιχτά, dogs & gaskets OK.
Weathertight doors close tight, dogs & gaskets OK.
Mahigpit sumara ang weathertight doors, OK ang dogs at gaskets.
Deck lights, flood lights, mast lights: ανάψτε όλα σήμερα το απόγευμα και αλλάξτε τις καμένες.
Deck lights, flood lights, mast lights: switch all on this evening and replace any blown bulbs.
Deck lights, flood lights, mast lights: buksan lahat ngayong gabi at palitan ang mga sira.
Paint store: ventilation, Ex-proof light, fire extinguishing, χωρίς κουρέλια/σκουπίδια.
Paint store: ventilation, Ex-proof light, fire extinguishing, no rags/rubbish.
Paint store: ventilation, Ex-proof light, pamatay-sunog, walang basahan/basura.
Oxy-acetylene: φιάλες δεμένες, valves κλειστά, flashback arrestors, hoses χωρίς ζημιά.
Oxy-acetylene: cylinders secured, valves closed, flashback arrestors, hoses not damaged.
Oxy-acetylene: nakatali ang cylinders, sarado ang valves, may flashback arrestors, walang sira ang hoses.
Handrails, ladders, walkways: τίποτα σάπιο, κομμένο ή δεμένο με σύρμα.
Handrails, ladders, walkways: nothing wasted, cut or tied with wire.
Handrails, ladders, walkways: walang bulok, putol o nakatali ng alambre.
Compression bars & water channels καθαρά, χωρίς κατάλοιπα φορτίου και σκουριά.
Compression bars & water channels clean, no cargo residues or rust.
Malinis ang compression bars at water channels, walang tira ng cargo o kalawang.
Drain holes καθαρά, non-return valves στη θέση και λειτουργούν.
Drain holes clear, non-return valves in place and working.
Malinis ang drain holes, nasa lugar at gumagana ang non-return valves.
Cleats όλα στη θέση, ελαστικές ροδέλες ΑΒΑΦΕΣ.
All cleats in place, rubber washers NOT painted.
Nasa lugar lahat ng cleats, HINDI pinintahan ang rubber washers.
Rubber seals: ΟΧΙ μπογιά, χωρίς σκισίματα ή permanent set.
Rubber seals: NO paint, no tears or permanent set.
Rubber seals: WALANG pintura, walang punit o permanent set.
Hydraulics: hoses χωρίς διαρροές/ρωγμές, καθαρό κάτω από cylinders, stoppers στη θέση.
Hydraulics: hoses without leaks/cracks, clean under cylinders, stoppers in place.
Hydraulics: walang tagas/bitak ang hoses, malinis sa ilalim ng cylinders, nasa lugar ang stoppers.
WIDS (water ingress alarms): test σήμερα και record.
WIDS (water ingress alarms): test today and record.
WIDS (water ingress alarms): i-test ngayon at i-record.
Σκάλες holds: rungs/platforms χωρίς σάπια ή λυγισμένα (αν μπει στο hold).
Hold ladders: rungs/platforms not wasted or bent (if he enters the hold).
Hold ladders: hindi bulok o baluktot ang rungs/platforms (kung papasok siya sa hold).
Cranes: limit switches & emergency stop δοκιμασμένα, cab καθαρή, controls σημασμένα.
Cranes: limit switches & emergency stop tested, cab clean, controls marked.
Cranes: na-test ang limit switches at emergency stop, malinis ang cab, may marka ang controls.
Cargo gear register: annual thorough examination & 5-yearly load test. Loose gear certificates (9A.22).
Cargo gear register: annual thorough examination & 5-yearly load test. Loose gear certificates (9A.22).
Cargo gear register: annual thorough examination at 5-yearly load test. Loose gear certificates (9A.22).
Loading computer: test condition των τελευταίων 3 μηνών, ταιριάζει με το booklet.
Loading computer: test condition within the last 3 months, matches the booklet.
Loading computer: test condition sa huling 3 buwan, tugma sa booklet.
Housekeeping: bilges στεγνά και χωρίς λάδι, plates χωρίς λάδια, καμία διαρροή. Steering room καθαρό.
Housekeeping: bilges dry and oil-free, plates oil-free, no leaks. Steering room clean.
Housekeeping: tuyo at walang langis ang bilges, walang langis ang plates, walang tagas. Malinis ang steering room.
OWS + 15 ppm alarm: δοκιμή σήμερα (θα το ζητήσει μπροστά του), 3-way valve επιστρέφει στο bilge, record στο ORB.
OWS + 15 ppm alarm: test today (he will ask to see it), 3-way valve returns to bilge, record in ORB.
OWS + 15 ppm alarm: i-test ngayon (hihingin niyang makita), bumabalik sa bilge ang 3-way valve, i-record sa ORB.
Em'cy fire pump: εκκίνηση σήμερα, πίεση στο ψηλότερο hydrant, οδηγίες εκκίνησης αναρτημένες.
Emergency fire pump: start today, pressure at the highest hydrant, starting instructions posted.
Emergency fire pump: paandarin ngayon, pressure sa pinakamataas na hydrant, nakapaskil ang starting instructions.
Em'cy generator: εκκίνηση auto & manual, οδηγίες αναρτημένες. Tank γεμάτο για ≥18 ώρες (7A.13) – γεμίστε σήμερα.
Emergency generator: start auto & manual, instructions posted. Tank full for at least 18 hours (7A.13) – top up today.
Emergency generator: paandarin auto at manual, nakapaskil ang instructions. Puno ang tank para sa 18 oras o higit (7A.13) – punuin ngayon.
Engineers' call alarm και dead man alarm (13.7): test σήμερα.
Engineers' call alarm and dead man alarm (13.7): test today.
Engineers' call alarm at dead man alarm (13.7): i-test ngayon.
Bilge high-level alarms: test και record.
Bilge high-level alarms: test and record.
Bilge high-level alarms: i-test at i-record.
Self-closing valves (gauge glasses, drains): ΚΑΝΕΝΑ δεμένο ανοιχτό.
Self-closing valves (gauge glasses, drains): NONE tied open.
Self-closing valves (gauge glasses, drains): WALANG nakataling bukas.
Sounding pipes: self-closing κλειστά, caps στη θέση.
Sounding pipes: self-closing closed, caps in place.
Sounding pipes: sarado ang self-closing, nakalagay ang caps.
Spray shields στα flanges FO/LO κοντά σε hot surfaces, μόνωση στη θέση. Lagging χωρίς λάδια (13.20).
Spray shields on FO/LO flanges near hot surfaces, insulation in place. Lagging not oil-soaked (13.20).
Spray shields sa FO/LO flanges malapit sa mainit na surface, nasa lugar ang insulation. Walang langis ang lagging (13.20).
Insulating mats μπροστά/πίσω MSB & ESB. Earth fault monitors (13.39) χωρίς ένδειξη.
Insulating mats in front/behind MSB & ESB. Earth fault monitors (13.39) show no fault.
Insulating mats sa harap/likod ng MSB at ESB. Walang fault sa earth fault monitors (13.39).
Guards σε όλα τα κινούμενα. Workshop (13.26): eye shields, guards, emergency stops, οδηγίες.
Guards on all moving parts. Workshop (13.26): eye shields, guards, emergency stops, instructions.
May guard lahat ng gumagalaw. Workshop (13.26): eye shields, guards, emergency stops, instructions.
Spare parts δεμένα και ασφαλισμένα (ER, stores, steering).
Spare parts lashed and secured (ER, stores, steering).
Nakatali at secure ang spare parts (ER, stores, steering).
Κανένα temporary repair, clamp ή τσιμέντο σε σωλήνες (και sea water lines 13.32).
No temporary repairs, clamps or cement boxes on pipes (also sea water lines 13.32).
Walang temporary repair, clamp o semento sa tubo (pati sea water lines 13.32).
Em'cy stops ventilation & fire flaps σημασμένα και δοκιμασμένα.
Ventilation emergency stops & fire flaps marked and tested.
May marka at na-test ang ventilation emergency stops at fire flaps.
Emergency steering drill ≤3 μηνών σε record. Reserve tank γεμάτο (13.41), heading indicator & communication (13.42), rudder angle indicator (13.43), οδηγίες αναρτημένες.
Emergency steering drill within 3 months recorded. Reserve tank full (13.41), heading indicator & communication (13.42), rudder angle indicator (13.43), instructions posted.
Emergency steering drill sa loob ng 3 buwan naka-record. Puno ang reserve tank (13.41), heading indicator at communication (13.42), rudder angle indicator (13.43), nakapaskil ang instructions.
Escape routes ελεύθερα, σημασμένα, φωτισμός OK.
Escape routes clear, marked, lighting OK.
Malinis at may marka ang escape routes, OK ang ilaw.
Alarm list ECR: καθαρή ή κάθε alarm εξηγημένο. Alarm printer σε σωστή ώρα.
ECR alarm list: clear, or each alarm explained. Alarm printer at correct time.
ECR alarm list: malinis, o may paliwanag ang bawat alarm. Tamang oras ang alarm printer.
Quick closing valves: τελευταίο test σε record.
Quick closing valves: last test recorded.
Quick closing valves: naka-record ang huling test.
Blackout recovery procedure αναρτημένη, οι engineers την ξέρουν.
Blackout recovery procedure posted, engineers know it.
Nakapaskil ang blackout recovery procedure, alam ng engineers.
Ψυγεία/κατάψυξη: man-trapped alarm δοκιμή, η πόρτα ανοίγει από μέσα.
Fridge/freezer rooms: test man-trapped alarm, door opens from inside.
Fridge/freezer rooms: i-test ang man-trapped alarm, nabubuksan ang pinto mula sa loob.
Hospital: καθαρό, ΜΟΝΟ για ιατρική χρήση, φάρμακα σε ισχύ.
Hospital: clean, ONLY for medical use, medicines in date.
Hospital: malinis, PARA LANG sa medical, hindi expired ang gamot.
Galley: φίλτρα απορροφητήρα χωρίς λίπη, fire blanket, ηλεκτρικές συσκευές OK.
Galley: hood filters free of grease, fire blanket, electrical appliances OK.
Galley: walang grasa ang hood filters, may fire blanket, OK ang electrical appliances.
Καμία αλυσίδα πολύπριζων, κρεμασμένα καλώδια ή ανοιχτά junction boxes.
No chained multi-plugs, hanging cables or open junction boxes.
Walang magkakabit na multi-plug, nakabitin na kable o bukas na junction box.
Cabins & mess καθαρά, Master's weekly inspection record.
Cabins & mess clean, Master's weekly inspection record.
Malinis ang cabins at mess, may record ng weekly inspection ng Master.
Potable water: test results, UV sterilizer/treatment λειτουργεί.
Potable water: test results, UV sterilizer/treatment working.
Potable water: may test results, gumagana ang UV sterilizer/treatment.
MSDS κοντά σε chemicals, paints, bunkers.
MSDS near chemicals, paints, bunkers.
MSDS malapit sa chemicals, paints, bunkers.
Κάπνισμα ΜΟΝΟ στα designated areas, σήμανση.
Smoking ONLY in designated areas, signs posted.
Paninigarilyo SA designated areas LANG, may signs.
Σταματήστε τις δουλειές στην ώρα τους: ΚΑΜΙΑ παραβίαση rest hours για την προετοιμασία. Ο inspector θα δει και αυτές τις μέρες.
Stop work on time: NO rest hour violation for the preparation. The inspector will check these days too.
Itigil ang trabaho sa oras: WALANG paglabag sa rest hours dahil sa paghahanda. Titingnan din ng inspector ang mga araw na ito.
Όχι μπογιά τελευταίας στιγμής πάνω σε σκουριά, rubber seals, cleat washers ή markings. Φρέσκια μπογιά = κρυμμένο defect για τον inspector.
No last-minute paint over rust, rubber seals, cleat washers or markings. Fresh paint = hidden defect to the inspector.
Walang huling-minutong pintura sa kalawang, rubber seals, cleat washers o markings. Bagong pintura = nakatagong depekto para sa inspector.
Καμία δουλειά μισή: όχι ανοιχτά μηχανήματα, ανοιχτά manholes, πεταμένα εργαλεία ή κρεμασμένα καλώδια.
No half-finished jobs: no opened machinery, open manholes, loose tools or hanging cables.
Walang kalahating trabaho: walang bukas na makina, bukas na manhole, nakakalat na tools o nakabitin na kable.
Όλα τα logs μέχρι σήμερα: deck & engine logbook, GMDSS, ORB, GRB, BWRB, bell book.
All logs up to today: deck & engine logbook, GMDSS, ORB, GRB, BWRB, bell book.
Lahat ng logs hanggang ngayon: deck at engine logbook, GMDSS, ORB, GRB, BWRB, bell book.
Briefing πληρώματος: «Δείξε, μη λες». Απαντάμε απλά και αληθινά· «θα σας δείξω πού είναι» είναι καλύτερο από ψέμα. Κάντε το 🎤 Drill συνέντευξης.
Crew briefing: “Show, don't tell.” Answer simply and truthfully; “I will show you where it is” is better than guessing. Do the 🎤 interview drill.
Crew briefing: “Ipakita, huwag sabihin.” Sumagot nang simple at totoo; “Ipapakita ko po kung nasaan” ay mas mabuti kaysa manghula. Gawin ang 🎤 interview drill.
Γρήγορο walk-round: φώτα, save-alls, πόρτες, extinguisher seals, fire boxes, housekeeping.
Quick walk-round: lights, save-alls, doors, extinguisher seals, fire boxes, housekeeping.
Mabilis na walk-round: ilaw, save-alls, pinto, seal ng extinguisher, fire boxes, housekeeping.
Όλοι στο deck με σωστό PPE (helmet, boots, gloves, coverall, goggles όπου χρειάζεται). Spare PPE για τον inspector.
Everyone on deck in correct PPE (helmet, boots, gloves, coverall, goggles where needed). Spare PPE for the inspector.
Lahat sa deck naka-tamang PPE (helmet, boots, gloves, coverall, goggles kung kailangan). May spare PPE para sa inspector.
Gangway watch στη θέση με visitor log και ID check (ελέγχει και τον inspector).
Gangway watch in place with visitor log and ID check (checks the inspector too).
Nasa lugar ang gangway watch na may visitor log at ID check (pati ang inspector).
Ο escort έχει φορητό gas detector (bump-tested) για κάθε χώρο που θα μπουν.
The escort carries a bump-tested portable gas detector for any space they enter.
May dalang bump-tested na portable gas detector ang escort para sa bawat space na papasukan.
Καμία hot work ή enclosed space entry κατά την επιθεώρηση χωρίς πλήρες permit.
No hot work or enclosed space entry during the inspection without a complete permit.
Walang hot work o pagpasok sa enclosed space habang may inspection nang walang kumpletong permit.
Engine room σε κανονική λειτουργία, ECR με αξιωματικό, γέφυρα με OOW (σε αγκυροβόλιο: anchor watch, BNWAS ON).
Engine room in normal operation, ECR manned, bridge with OOW (at anchor: anchor watch, BNWAS ON).
Normal ang operation ng engine room, may tao sa ECR, may OOW sa bridge (naka-angkla: anchor watch, BNWAS ON).
Ο escort δεν αφήνει τον inspector και σημειώνει κάθε παρατήρηση με τη θέση της.
The escort stays with the inspector and writes down every remark with its location.
Hindi iiwan ng escort ang inspector at isusulat ang bawat puna kasama ang lokasyon.
Ό,τι βρει και διορθώνεται: διόρθωσέ το αμέσως, φωτογραφία πριν/μετά. Βοηθάει στο close-out.
Anything he finds that can be fixed: fix it at once, photo before/after. It helps the close-out.
Anumang makita niya na kayang ayusin: ayusin agad, may photo bago/pagkatapos. Makakatulong sa close-out.
Δεν διαφωνούμε έντονα. Αν υπάρχει απόδειξη (record/certificate), τη δείχνουμε ήρεμα επί τόπου.
Do not argue. If there is evidence (record/certificate), show it calmly on the spot.
Huwag makipagtalo. Kung may ebidensya (record/certificate), ipakita nang mahinahon doon mismo.
Closing meeting: διάβασε κάθε finding, ζήτα σωστή διατύπωση και σωστή RISQ ερώτηση, κράτα αντίγραφο. Ενημέρωσε γραφείο την ίδια μέρα.
Closing meeting: read every finding, ask for correct wording and the correct RISQ question, keep a copy. Inform the office the same day.
Closing meeting: basahin ang bawat finding, humingi ng tamang wording at tamang RISQ question, magtabi ng kopya. Ipaalam sa office sa parehong araw.
